title: Ref2Light: From One Image to Interactive Glasses-Free 3D Characters
abstract: arXiv:2611.29678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Animating character illustrations on light-field displays demands coherent binocular parallax, real-time pose articulation, and fine-grained expression control. However, existing 2D animation and 3D reconstruction pipelines cannot combine these with rapid character switching. We present Ref2Light, a feed-forward framework that maps a single A-pose illustration and continuous pose and expression controls to display-native light-field animation, without per-character 3D reconstruction, rigging, or test-time optimization. Our key insight is to decompose light-field synthesis into static identity, view-dependent parallax, and control-driven articulation. A shared encoder caches multi-scale identity features once per character for rapid switching. translated_title: Ref2Light：从单张图像到交互式裸眼3D角色
translated_abstract: 在光场显示器上为角色插画制作动画，需要连贯的双目视差、实时的姿态关节运动以及细粒度的表情控制。然而，现有的2D动画和3D重建流程无法将这些需求与快速角色切换相结合。我们提出了Ref2Light，一个前馈框架，它将单张A-pose（标准姿势）插画与连续的姿态和表情控制信号直接映射为显示器原生的光场动画，无需针对每个角色进行3D重建、骨骼绑定或测试时优化。我们的关键洞察是将光场合成分解为三个部分：静态身份特征、视角相关的视差以及控制驱动的关节运动。共享编码器为每个角色仅缓存一次多尺度身份特征，从而实现快速角色切换。条件解码器随后通过反向纹理传输和直接颜色合成，从这些特征合成有序的角度锚点。全局-局部控制方案对锚点进行变形……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: Ref2Light是一个前馈框架，能从单张A-pose插画直接生成可实时控制姿态与表情的裸眼3D光场角色动画，无需3D重建或骨骼绑定，并支持快速角色切换。
en_tdlr: Ref2Light is a feed-forward framework that generates interactive glasses-free 3D light-field character animations from a single A-pose illustration with real-time pose and expression control, requiring no per-character 3D reconstruction, rigging, or test-time optimization.
